_meta.description: Seed card rules for a Singapore miles-card optimiser. All mpd values are KrisFlyer miles per S$1.
primary_sources: Individual Mainly Miles reviews linked per card
Bank T&Cs are the final word; re-check before relying on any rule
warnings: Banks change terms often. Every card has last_verified; re-check anything older than ~3 months.
needs_verification: true means the MCC list or detail was not confirmed from a primary or detailed source.
Sign-up bonuses change monthly and are deliberately kept short here.
Codes in no_points.mccs were translated from the source's wording unless the source listed codes itself; those lists are marked needs_verification.

payment_methods.mobile_tap: Apple/Google/Samsung Pay tapped at a terminal
payment_methods.online_card_entry: Card number entered or stored on a website/app
payment_methods.in_app_wallet: Apple/Google Pay used inside an app or website (e.g. Kris+, foodpanda checkout)

earn_block_types.per_txn_floor: Each transaction rounded DOWN to size_sgd before points are awarded
earn_block_types.per_txn_nearest: Each transaction rounded to the nearest size_sgd
earn_block_types.monthly_pooled_floor: Eligible spend summed for the month, then rounded down once

schema.base_mpd: { local, fcy }: miles per S$1 when no bonus rule applies.
schema.earn_block: How spend is rounded for base miles. bonus_earn_block (optional) overrides it for bonus miles. earn_block_overrides apply to listed methods.
schema.cap_period: calendar_month | statement_month | null (null = calendar_month). Applies to every cap, pool and minimum spend on the card.
schema.cap_basis: posting_date | transaction_date | null (null = unknown; the app treats it as posting_date to be safe).
schema.caps: Named cap buckets { bucket_id: { sgd, label?, min_spend_sgd?, rank_until_min_met?, hard_limit?, needs_verification? } }. Rules that share a bucket share its cap. label is the name she sees (default: the id with spaces).
schema.min_spend: Card-level minimum: { sgd, failure }. failure 'all_base' = every purchase that cycle earns base_mpd.
schema.caps.*.min_spend_sgd: Bucket-level minimum: spend in the bucket must reach this or the bucket earns base_mpd.
schema.caps.*.rank_until_min_met: bonus (default: rank at the bonus rate with a 'needs S$X more' warning) | base (rank at base_mpd until the minimum is met).
schema.caps.*.hard_limit: true = spend in the bucket must not pass sgd; the app never recommends a purchase that would.
schema.min_spend.rank_until_met: bonus only for now: rank at the bonus rate with a 'needs S$X more' warning.
schema.bonus_rules[].methods: List of payment_methods the rule applies to.
schema.bonus_rules[].match.mode: whitelist (mccs listed earn) | blacklist (all earn except mccs) | all | categories (category ids from data/categories.json) | merchants (merchant name contains any listed) | user_category (she picks one option; option_categories maps each to category ids)
schema.bonus_rules[].cap_bucket: Key into caps, or null for uncapped.
schema.bonus_rules[].valid_from / valid_until: Optional 'YYYY-MM-DD' dates; the rule only applies to purchases in that window.
schema.bonus_rules[].promotion: true = time-limited promotion; the app shows when it ends.
schema.bonus_rules[].disputed: [{ id, merchants | recurring: true, note, question, resolved? }]: sources disagree for these merchants (or for all recurring payments). The rate still applies, marked unconfirmed, with the note shown, until her statement answers `question` (stored on her phone) or `resolved: "confirmed"` is set here.
schema.bonus_rules[].match.exclude_merchants: Merchant names this rule never applies to (base rate instead), e.g. after a statement showed no bonus.
schema.bonus_rules[].match.exclude_mccs: Category codes this rule never applies to, whatever the mode (e.g. supermarket-coded purchases at a named platform).
schema.bonus_rules[].match.option_mccs: user_category only: { option: [codes] }. When her chosen option has codes, they decide the match (confirmed); otherwise option_categories is used (unconfirmed).
schema.bonus_rules[].condition: A condition the app cannot check. The rule is shown as conditional and not counted unless she marks it met.
schema.no_points: Purchases that earn nothing on this card: { mccs, merchants, notes, needs_verification }.
schema.bonus_rules[].match.exclude_recurring: true = recurring payments (categories.json recurring: true, e.g. subscriptions) earn base on this rule.
schema.bonus_rules[].label: Title of the rule's box on the card sheet, naming its category (e.g. 'Dining', 'Overseas spending').
schema.bonus_rules[].match.option_labels: user_category only: { option: name she sees } when the stored option value doesn't follow the writing style.
schema.dev_notes: On a card, cap or rule: detail for whoever maintains this file. Never shown in the app. Everything else she sees follows the writing style in CLAUDE.md.
schema.miles_per_point: KrisFlyer miles per bank point, for showing points balances.
schema.fee_reminder: Text shown on the annual fee reminder.
